# USOS answer profile "Lab" (docs/answer-profiles.md).
# No disk or boot loader keys: partitioning always stays in the installer.
d-i cdrom-detect/try-usb boolean true
d-i debian-installer/locale string en_GB.UTF-8
d-i keyboard-configuration/xkb-keymap select us
d-i netcfg/get_hostname string lab-pc-2
d-i netcfg/hostname string lab-pc-2
d-i netcfg/get_domain string
d-i passwd/root-login boolean false
d-i passwd/user-fullname string Jan Kowalski
d-i passwd/username string jan_kowalski
d-i clock-setup/utc boolean true
